summary:
Field Shift: Four Seasons of Amma’s Field is an interactive, story-driven agricultural adaptation experience that explores how changing climate conditions affect farming and the decisions farmers make. We developed a digital farm experience combining regional storytelling, gameplay, environmental data and visualizations, with dedicated experiences for Punjab and Karnataka.

The project uses NASA POWER climate data to explore historical weather patterns and NASA GIBS satellite imagery to connect the experience with observations of Earth. Players explore farming scenarios, strategies and challenges through interactive journeys and missions.

Field Shift addresses the challenge of climate adaptation by making environmental information more accessible and showing how climate conditions can influence agricultural decisions. It is important because farmers face growing uncertainty from changing rainfall and temperature patterns. Our goal is to support awareness and informed decision-making through an engaging educational tool, while emphasizing that technology should support farmers and local expertise, not replace them.
details:
Four Seasons of Amma’s Field is a story-driven agricultural adaptation simulation that explores how farmers can make informed decisions in response to changing weather and climate conditions. Through interactive gameplay and regional storytelling, the project connects agricultural practices with NASA Earth observation and climate data.

GitHub: https://github.com/dangolzenith12-code/Project-Field-Shift
Live Website: https://dangolzenith12-code.github.io/Project-Field-Shift/

How It Works

The platform combines an interactive farm experience with region-specific agricultural information. Players explore different farming environments through two experiences: Overworld, featuring Hari’s Journey and Mission Conquest, and Storymode, featuring stories from Karnataka and Punjab.

The experience uses weather information from NASA POWER and satellite visualization through NASA GIBS. These data sources help connect the gameplay to real environmental conditions and demonstrate how climate information can inform agricultural decisions.

Players interact with farming scenarios, explore tools and strategies, and learn about the challenges farmers face across different regions.

Tools and Technologies

  • Frontend: Svelte 5, Vite, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.
  • Environmental Data: NASA POWER.
  • Satellite Visualization: NASA GIBS.
  • Mapping and Elevation: Open Topo Data.
  • Development: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python.
  • Version Control: Git and GitHub.
  • Hosting: GitHub Pages.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project aims to make climate and agricultural information more accessible through an interactive experience. It demonstrates how environmental data can be translated into understandable farming scenarios.

Its intended benefits include:

  • Improving awareness of the effects of changing weather on agriculture.
  • Helping users explore region-specific farming challenges.
  • Demonstrating how NASA Earth data can support agricultural understanding.
  • Encouraging informed decision-making through interactive learning.
  • Connecting technology, storytelling, and climate adaptation.

Creativity and Design Considerations

The central idea is to combine interactive storytelling, gameplay, and real environmental data rather than present agricultural information through charts and technical reports alone.

The experience keeps Overworld and Storymode as separate paths, allowing users to explore gameplay missions as well as regional farming stories. Its visual design draws on regional agricultural identity while keeping the interface accessible and engaging.

The long-term goal is to create an educational experience that helps people understand the relationship between climate, farming practices, and agricultural resilience.
